search_text: published ZDI-17-043 ZDI-CAN-3679 Advantech WebAccess updateTemplate SQL Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2017-01-12 CVE-2017-5154 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-5154 6.5 ['Advantech'] ['WebAccess'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Advantech WebAccess.
